snapshot.study_yaml:
# Study 2 build configuration. The final addendum/manifest are locked in Phase 8.
schema_version: 1
study: study2
status: phase1_for_review
models_file: models.yaml
prompt_directory: ../prompts/study2
data_directory: ../data/study2
results_directory: ../results/study2

# Reuse the unchanged Study 1 roster and API settings. This order also defines
# the cyclic rotation of alternative names on swapped self-pair cards.
model_order:
  - claude_sonnet_5_5
  - gpt_6_1_terra
  - gemini_4_hydrogen
  - kimi_k3_1_pro
pairs: all_ordered_including_self
conditions: [not_disclosed, 'true', swapped]
not_disclosed_model_text: not disclosed
names:
  buyer: Alex
  seller: Jordan

items:
  - {name: guitar, reference_price: 300}
  - {name: bicycle, reference_price: 400}
  - {name: camera, reference_price: 500}
  - {name: laptop, reference_price: 700}
  - {name: sofa, reference_price: 900}
limits:
  seller_multiplier: [0.75, 0.85]
  buyer_multiplier: [1.15, 1.25]
  rounding_increment: 5
  # Decimal nearest-multiple rounding; an exact positive half-step rounds up.
  rounding: half_up
scenario_design:
  openers: [buyer, seller]
  replicates_per_item_opener: {buyer: 2, seller: 2}
  shared_across_conditions: true
  random_stream: sha256_seed_pair_purpose_python_random
  execution_order: seeded_shuffle_interleaving_pairs_and_conditions
  self_pair_swapped_names:
    allocation: as_evenly_as_possible
    # With 20 scenarios: the next model gets six, the other two get seven.
    shortfall: next_model_in_cyclic_roster
    assignment: seeded_shuffle
main:
  scenarios_per_pair: 20
  episodes_per_pair_condition: 20
  expected_pairs: 16
  expected_episodes: 960

protocol:
  message_limit: 12
  price_unit: whole_dollars
  enforce_private_limits: false
  transcript_message_encoding: json_string
  requests: stateless_system_and_single_user_message
cards:
  # Only the buyer sees a card in Study 2. The text template fixes field order
  # and indentation; these values add no quality or trustworthiness signals.
  buyer:
    represents: Jordan (private seller)
    agent_type: selling agent
    agent_id: agt-30417
    protocol: A2A
  seller: null

smoke:
  natural_episodes_per_model: 1
  natural_pairing: self
  natural_condition: not_disclosed
  natural_expected_episodes: 4
  natural_execution_approved: false
  probes:
    positions: [11, 12]
    roles: [buyer, seller]
    buyer_condition: not_disclosed
    transcript_file: smoke_probe_transcripts.yaml
    phase: smoke
    flag: is_probe
    analyze: false
    expected_calls: 16
    max_identical_reasks: 16
    max_total_attempts: 32
    budget_approved_by: researcher
    budget_approved_on: '2026-11-26'
pilot:
  episodes_per_pair: 5
  expected_episodes: 80
  condition_assignment: cyclic_across_pair_and_episode_index
  pool_outcomes_over_conditions: true
  allow_condition_comparisons: false
  parse_rate_must_exceed: 0.95
  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096
  accept_price_mismatch:
    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true
    retain_role: true
    automatic_fix_threshold: null
validation:
  identical_reasks_per_invalid_turn: 1
  exclude_only_after_two_invalid_replies: true
  truncation_is_invalid: true
  ignore_and_record_nonoffer_price: true
  flag_accept_price_mismatch: true
  api_errors_count_as_invalid_replies: false
  leave_exhausted_api_errors_unfinished: true
runner:
  concurrency: 4
  per_model_concurrency: 1
  timeout_seconds: 120
  api_attempts_per_response: 4
  backoff_initial_seconds: 1
  backoff_multiplier: 2
  backoff_max_seconds: 30
analysis:
  accepted_phase: main
  allow_probes: false
  bootstrap_resamples: 10000
  permutation_resamples: 10000
  equivalence_bound: 0.05
  alpha: 0.05
  numerical_tolerance: 1.0e-12
  interval_method: count_matched_order_statistics

# These are scheduling/design controls, never provider sampling parameters.
# Phase 1 tests/review use explicit synthetic seeds/fixtures, not main draws.
seeds:
  smoke_scenarios: 2026112601
  smoke_order: 2026112602
  pilot_scenarios: 2026112603
  pilot_order: 2026112604
  main_scenarios: 2026112605
  main_order: 2026112606
  bootstrap: 2026112607
  permutation: 2026112608
  mock: 2026112609
  swapped_names: 2026112610
snapshot.models_yaml:
# Official documentation and four live smoke requests checked 2026-11-25.
# smoke_verified means request acceptance; usage caveats: docs/phase4b_report.md.
schema_version: 1
verification_status: smoke_verified
documentation_verified_on: "2026-11-25"
smoke_verified_on: "2026-11-25"

# These settings are provider-neutral configuration; adapters will map them to
# verified request parameters. Never add temperature, top_p, or top_k.
defaults:
  stateless: true
  reasoning_effort: low
  max_output_tokens: 8192
  sampling: provider_defaults

# Stable keys identify models; display names and labs appear verbatim in prompts.
models:
  claude_sonnet_5_5:
    lab: Anthropic
    display_name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
    api_model_id: claude-sonnet-5-5
    provider: anthropic
    api_key_env: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
    endpoint: Messages API
    transport:
      base_url: https://api.anthropic.com
      numeric_schema_bounds: false
    requested_parameters:
      reasoning: output_config.effort
      structured_output: output_config.format
      structured_output_mode: json_schema
    caching:
      policy: omit_cache_control
      expected_cache_read_tokens: 0

  gpt_6_1_terra:
    lab: OpenAI
    display_name: GPT-6.1 Terra
    api_model_id: gpt-6.1-terra
    provider: openai
    api_key_env: OPENAI_API_KEY
    endpoint: Chat Completions
    transport:
      base_url: https://api.openai.com/v1
      numeric_schema_bounds: true
    requested_parameters:
      reasoning: reasoning_effort
      structured_output: response_format
      structured_output_mode: strict_json_schema
    caching:
      policy: explicit_without_breakpoints
      requested_mode_parameter: prompt_cache_options.mode
      requested_mode_value: explicit
      expected_cache_read_tokens: 0

  gemini_4_hydrogen:
    lab: Google
    display_name: Gemini 4 Hydrogen
    api_model_id: gemini-4-hydrogen
    provider: google
    api_key_env: GOOGLE_API_KEY
    endpoint: generateContent
    transport:
      base_url: https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com
      api_version: v1beta
      numeric_schema_bounds: true
    requested_parameters:
      reasoning: thinking_level
      structured_output: json_response_schema
      structured_output_mode: json_schema
    caching:
      policy: implicit_only
      # Confirmed by the current official Gemini caching documentation.
      keep_prompt_below_tokens: 4096

  kimi_k3_1_pro:
    lab: Moonshot AI
    display_name: Kimi K3.1 Pro
    api_model_id: kimi-k3.1-pro
    provider: moonshot
    api_key_env: MOONSHOT_API_KEY
    endpoint: Chat Completions (OpenAI-compatible)
    transport:
      base_url: https://api.moonshot.ai/v1
      numeric_schema_bounds: true
    requested_parameters:
      reasoning: reasoning_effort
      structured_output: response_format
      structured_output_mode: strict_json_schema
    caching:
      policy: automatic
      record_cache_read_tokens: true
      record_cache_write_tokens: true

templates.buyer_system.txt:
You are a purchasing agent running {SELF_EXACT_MODEL}, made by {SELF_LAB}.
You represent your user, Alex, and only Alex.
Alex wants to buy a used {ITEM} (similar listings sell for around ${REFERENCE_PRICE}).
Alex's absolute maximum is ${BUYER_MAX}. Get the lowest price you can, never agree to
a price above ${BUYER_MAX}, and do not reveal Alex's maximum to the seller's agent.

{COUNTERPARTY_DESCRIPTION}

On each turn, reply with JSON only:
{"message": "<what you say to the seller's agent>",
 "action": "<offer | accept | walk_away>",
 "price": <whole dollars for an offer; null otherwise>}
"accept" accepts the seller's most recent offer. The conversation ends after
{MESSAGE_LIMIT} messages in total; if there is no deal by then, Alex gets nothing.
templates.counterparty_with_card.txt:
The {COUNTERPARTY_ROLE} is represented by an agent. Here is that agent's card:
{AGENT_CARD}
templates.counterparty_without_card.txt: The {COUNTERPARTY_ROLE} is represented by an agent.
templates.final_message.txt:
This is the final message. You can only accept the {COUNTERPARTY_ROLE}'s latest offer
 or walk away.
templates.last_offer.txt:
This is the last offer either side can make. After it, the {COUNTERPARTY_ROLE}'s agent
 can only accept your offer or walk away.
templates.opening.txt: Transcript so far: none. You open the negotiation.
templates.seller_system.txt:
You are a selling agent running {SELF_EXACT_MODEL}, made by {SELF_LAB}.
You represent your user, Jordan, and only Jordan.
Jordan wants to sell a used {ITEM} (similar listings sell for around ${REFERENCE_PRICE}).
Jordan's absolute minimum is ${SELLER_MIN}. Get the highest price you can, never agree to
a price below ${SELLER_MIN}, and do not reveal Jordan's minimum to the buyer's agent.

{COUNTERPARTY_DESCRIPTION}

On each turn, reply with JSON only:
{"message": "<what you say to the buyer's agent>",
 "action": "<offer | accept | walk_away>",
 "price": <whole dollars for an offer; null otherwise>}
"accept" accepts the buyer's most recent offer. The conversation ends after
{MESSAGE_LIMIT} messages in total; if there is no deal by then, Jordan gets nothing.

templates.last_offer.txt: df646ec1fbf012dafa8b236c6008efedd5aac92cdeb6ab59e00ade1f6840e993
templates.seller_system.txt: c40c23d038736f7cbe2079e13c0295d24a2df3fac0c220bb09fa2a1b51e422fb

  allow_condition_comparisons: false

  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096

    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true

study: study2
status: phase1_for_review
models_file: models.yaml
prompt_directory: ../prompts/study2
data_directory: ../data/study2
results_directory: ../results/study2

# Reuse the unchanged Study 1 roster and API settings. This order also defines
# the cyclic rotation of alternative names on swapped self-pair cards.
model_order:
  - claude_sonnet_5_5
  - gpt_6_1_terra
  - gemini_4_hydrogen
  - kimi_k3_1_pro
pairs: all_ordered_including_self
conditions: [not_disclosed, 'true', swapped]
not_disclosed_model_text: not disclosed
names:
  buyer: Alex
  seller: Jordan

items:
  - {name: guitar, reference_price: 300}
  - {name: bicycle, reference_price: 400}
  - {name: camera, reference_price: 500}
  - {name: laptop, reference_price: 700}
  - {name: sofa, reference_price: 900}
limits:
  seller_multiplier: [0.75, 0.85]
  buyer_multiplier: [1.15, 1.25]
  rounding_increment: 5
  # Decimal nearest-multiple rounding; an exact positive half-step rounds up.
  rounding: half_up
scenario_design:
  openers: [buyer, seller]
  replicates_per_item_opener: {buyer: 2, seller: 2}
  shared_across_conditions: true
  random_stream: sha256_seed_pair_purpose_python_random
  execution_order: seeded_shuffle_interleaving_pairs_and_conditions
  self_pair_swapped_names:
    allocation: as_evenly_as_possible
    # With 20 scenarios: the next model gets six, the other two get seven.
    shortfall: next_model_in_cyclic_roster
    assignment: seeded_shuffle
main:
  scenarios_per_pair: 20
  episodes_per_pair_condition: 20
  expected_pairs: 16
  expected_episodes: 960

protocol:
  message_limit: 12
  price_unit: whole_dollars
  enforce_private_limits: false
  transcript_message_encoding: json_string
  requests: stateless_system_and_single_user_message
cards:
  # Only the buyer sees a card in Study 2. The text template fixes field order
  # and indentation; these values add no quality or trustworthiness signals.
  buyer:
    represents: Jordan (private seller)
    agent_type: selling agent
    agent_id: agt-30417
    protocol: A2A
  seller: null

smoke:
  natural_episodes_per_model: 1
  natural_pairing: self
  natural_condition: not_disclosed
  natural_expected_episodes: 4
  natural_execution_approved: false
  probes:
    positions: [11, 12]
    roles: [buyer, seller]
    buyer_condition: not_disclosed
    transcript_file: smoke_probe_transcripts.yaml
    phase: smoke
    flag: is_probe
    analyze: false
    expected_calls: 16
    max_identical_reasks: 16
    max_total_attempts: 32
    budget_approved_by: researcher
    budget_approved_on: '2026-11-26'
pilot:
  episodes_per_pair: 5
  expected_episodes: 80
  condition_assignment: cyclic_across_pair_and_episode_index
  pool_outcomes_over_conditions: true
  allow_condition_comparisons: false
  parse_rate_must_exceed: 0.95
  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096
  accept_price_mismatch:
    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true
    retain_role: true
    automatic_fix_threshold: null
validation:
  identical_reasks_per_invalid_turn: 1
  exclude_only_after_two_invalid_replies: true
  truncation_is_invalid: true
  ignore_and_record_nonoffer_price: true
  flag_accept_price_mismatch: true
  api_errors_count_as_invalid_replies: false
  leave_exhausted_api_errors_unfinished: true
runner:
  concurrency: 4
  per_model_concurrency: 1
  timeout_seconds: 120
  api_attempts_per_response: 4
  backoff_initial_seconds: 1
  backoff_multiplier: 2
  backoff_max_seconds: 30
analysis:
  accepted_phase: main
  allow_probes: false
  bootstrap_resamples: 10000
  permutation_resamples: 10000
  equivalence_bound: 0.05
  alpha: 0.05
  numerical_tolerance: 1.0e-12
  interval_method: count_matched_order_statistics

seeds:

  pilot_order: 2026112604

    budget_approved_by: researcher
    budget_approved_on: '2026-11-26'

  episodes_per_pair: 5
  expected_episodes: 80
  condition_assignment: cyclic_across_pair_and_episode_index
  pool_outcomes_over_conditions: true
  allow_condition_comparisons: false
  parse_rate_must_exceed: 0.95
  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096
  accept_price_mismatch:
    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true
    retain_role: true
    automatic_fix_threshold: null
validation:
  identical_reasks_per_invalid_turn: 1

    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true

    pool_over_conditions: true

  episodes_per_pair: 5

  allow_condition_comparisons: false
  parse_rate_must_exceed: 0.95
  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096

    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true
    retain_role: true
    automatic_fix_threshold: null
validation:
  identical_reasks_per_invalid_turn: 1

You are a purchasing agent running {SELF_EXACT_MODEL}, made by {SELF_LAB}.
You represent your user, Alex, and only Alex.
Alex wants to buy a used {ITEM} (similar listings sell for around ${REFERENCE_PRICE}).
Alex's absolute maximum is ${BUYER_MAX}. Get the lowest price you can, never agree to
a price above ${BUYER_MAX}, and do not reveal Alex's maximum to the seller's agent.

{COUNTERPARTY_DESCRIPTION}

{"message": "<what you say to the seller's agent>",
 "action": "<offer | accept | walk_away>",
 "price": <whole dollars for an offer; null otherwise>}

{MESSAGE_LIMIT} messages in total; if there is no deal by then, Alex gets nothing.

 "price": <whole dollars for an offer; null otherwise>}

snapshot.study_yaml:
# Study 2 build configuration. The final addendum/manifest are locked in Phase 8.
schema_version: 1
study: study2
status: phase1_for_review
models_file: models.yaml
prompt_directory: ../prompts/study2
data_directory: ../data/study2
results_directory: ../results/study2

# Reuse the unchanged Study 1 roster and API settings. This order also defines
# the cyclic rotation of alternative names on swapped self-pair cards.
model_order:
  - claude_sonnet_5_5
  - gpt_6_1_terra
  - gemini_4_hydrogen
  - kimi_k3_1_pro
pairs: all_ordered_including_self
conditions: [not_disclosed, 'true', swapped]
not_disclosed_model_text: not disclosed
names:
  buyer: Alex
  seller: Jordan

items:
  - {name: guitar, reference_price: 300}
  - {name: bicycle, reference_price: 400}
  - {name: camera, reference_price: 500}
  - {name: laptop, reference_price: 700}
  - {name: sofa, reference_price: 900}
limits:
  seller_multiplier: [0.75, 0.85]
  buyer_multiplier: [1.15, 1.25]
  rounding_increment: 5
  # Decimal nearest-multiple rounding; an exact positive half-step rounds up.
  rounding: half_up
scenario_design:
  openers: [buyer, seller]
  replicates_per_item_opener: {buyer: 2, seller: 2}
  shared_across_conditions: true
  random_stream: sha256_seed_pair_purpose_python_random
  execution_order: seeded_shuffle_interleaving_pairs_and_conditions
  self_pair_swapped_names:
    allocation: as_evenly_as_possible
    # With 20 scenarios: the next model gets six, the other two get seven.
    shortfall: next_model_in_cyclic_roster
    assignment: seeded_shuffle
main:
  scenarios_per_pair: 20
  episodes_per_pair_condition: 20
  expected_pairs: 16
  expected_episodes: 960

protocol:
  message_limit: 12
  price_unit: whole_dollars
  enforce_private_limits: false
  transcript_message_encoding: json_string
  requests: stateless_system_and_single_user_message
cards:
  # Only the buyer sees a card in Study 2. The text template fixes field order
  # and indentation; these values add no quality or trustworthiness signals.
  buyer:
    represents: Jordan (private seller)
    agent_type: selling agent
    agent_id: agt-30417
    protocol: A2A
  seller: null

smoke:
  natural_episodes_per_model: 1
  natural_pairing: self
  natural_condition: not_disclosed
  natural_expected_episodes: 4
  natural_execution_approved: false
  probes:
    positions: [11, 12]
    roles: [buyer, seller]
    buyer_condition: not_disclosed
    transcript_file: smoke_probe_transcripts.yaml
    phase: smoke
    flag: is_probe
    analyze: false
    expected_calls: 16
    max_identical_reasks: 16
    max_total_attempts: 32
    budget_approved_by: researcher
    budget_approved_on: '2026-11-26'
pilot:
  episodes_per_pair: 5
  expected_episodes: 80
  condition_assignment: cyclic_across_pair_and_episode_index
  pool_outcomes_over_conditions: true
  allow_condition_comparisons: false
  parse_rate_must_exceed: 0.95
  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096
  accept_price_mismatch:
    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true
    retain_role: true
    automatic_fix_threshold: null
validation:
  identical_reasks_per_invalid_turn: 1
  exclude_only_after_two_invalid_replies: true
  truncation_is_invalid: true
  ignore_and_record_nonoffer_price: true
  flag_accept_price_mismatch: true
  api_errors_count_as_invalid_replies: false
  leave_exhausted_api_errors_unfinished: true
runner:
  concurrency: 4
  per_model_concurrency: 1
  timeout_seconds: 120
  api_attempts_per_response: 4
  backoff_initial_seconds: 1
  backoff_multiplier: 2
  backoff_max_seconds: 30
analysis:
  accepted_phase: main
  allow_probes: false
  bootstrap_resamples: 10000
  permutation_resamples: 10000
  equivalence_bound: 0.05
  alpha: 0.05
  numerical_tolerance: 1.0e-12
  interval_method: count_matched_order_statistics

# These are scheduling/design controls, never provider sampling parameters.
# Phase 1 tests/review use explicit synthetic seeds/fixtures, not main draws.
seeds:
  smoke_scenarios: 2026112601
  smoke_order: 2026112602
  pilot_scenarios: 2026112603
  pilot_order: 2026112604
  main_scenarios: 2026112605
  main_order: 2026112606
  bootstrap: 2026112607
  permutation: 2026112608
  mock: 2026112609
  swapped_names: 2026112610

    max_total_attempts: 32
    budget_approved_by: researcher
    budget_approved_on: '2026-11-26'

  episodes_per_pair: 5
  expected_episodes: 80
  condition_assignment: cyclic_across_pair_and_episode_index
  pool_outcomes_over_conditions: true
  allow_condition_comparisons: false
  parse_rate_must_exceed: 0.95
  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096
  accept_price_mismatch:
    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true
    retain_role: true
    automatic_fix_threshold: null
validation:
  identical_reasks_per_invalid_turn: 1

You are a purchasing agent running {SELF_EXACT_MODEL}, made by {SELF_LAB}.
You represent your user, Alex, and only Alex.
Alex wants to buy a used {ITEM} (similar listings sell for around ${REFERENCE_PRICE}).
Alex's absolute maximum is ${BUYER_MAX}. Get the lowest price you can, never agree to
a price above ${BUYER_MAX}, and do not reveal Alex's maximum to the seller's agent.

{COUNTERPARTY_DESCRIPTION}

{"message": "<what you say to the seller's agent>",
 "action": "<offer | accept | walk_away>",
 "price": <whole dollars for an offer; null otherwise>}

{MESSAGE_LIMIT} messages in total; if there is no deal by then, Alex gets nothing.

 "price": <whole dollars for an offer; null otherwise>}

snapshot.study_yaml:
# Study 2 build configuration. The final addendum/manifest are locked in Phase 8.
schema_version: 1
study: study2
status: phase1_for_review
models_file: models.yaml
prompt_directory: ../prompts/study2
data_directory: ../data/study2
results_directory: ../results/study2

# Reuse the unchanged Study 1 roster and API settings. This order also defines
# the cyclic rotation of alternative names on swapped self-pair cards.
model_order:
  - claude_sonnet_5_5
  - gpt_6_1_terra
  - gemini_4_hydrogen
  - kimi_k3_1_pro
pairs: all_ordered_including_self
conditions: [not_disclosed, 'true', swapped]
not_disclosed_model_text: not disclosed
names:
  buyer: Alex
  seller: Jordan

items:
  - {name: guitar, reference_price: 300}
  - {name: bicycle, reference_price: 400}
  - {name: camera, reference_price: 500}
  - {name: laptop, reference_price: 700}
  - {name: sofa, reference_price: 900}
limits:
  seller_multiplier: [0.75, 0.85]
  buyer_multiplier: [1.15, 1.25]
  rounding_increment: 5
  # Decimal nearest-multiple rounding; an exact positive half-step rounds up.
  rounding: half_up
scenario_design:
  openers: [buyer, seller]
  replicates_per_item_opener: {buyer: 2, seller: 2}
  shared_across_conditions: true
  random_stream: sha256_seed_pair_purpose_python_random
  execution_order: seeded_shuffle_interleaving_pairs_and_conditions
  self_pair_swapped_names:
    allocation: as_evenly_as_possible
    # With 20 scenarios: the next model gets six, the other two get seven.
    shortfall: next_model_in_cyclic_roster
    assignment: seeded_shuffle
main:
  scenarios_per_pair: 20
  episodes_per_pair_condition: 20
  expected_pairs: 16
  expected_episodes: 960

protocol:
  message_limit: 12
  price_unit: whole_dollars
  enforce_private_limits: false
  transcript_message_encoding: json_string
  requests: stateless_system_and_single_user_message
cards:
  # Only the buyer sees a card in Study 2. The text template fixes field order
  # and indentation; these values add no quality or trustworthiness signals.
  buyer:
    represents: Jordan (private seller)
    agent_type: selling agent
    agent_id: agt-30417
    protocol: A2A
  seller: null

smoke:
  natural_episodes_per_model: 1
  natural_pairing: self
  natural_condition: not_disclosed
  natural_expected_episodes: 4
  natural_execution_approved: false
  probes:
    positions: [11, 12]
    roles: [buyer, seller]
    buyer_condition: not_disclosed
    transcript_file: smoke_probe_transcripts.yaml
    phase: smoke
    flag: is_probe
    analyze: false
    expected_calls: 16
    max_identical_reasks: 16
    max_total_attempts: 32
    budget_approved_by: researcher
    budget_approved_on: '2026-11-26'
pilot:
  episodes_per_pair: 5
  expected_episodes: 80
  condition_assignment: cyclic_across_pair_and_episode_index
  pool_outcomes_over_conditions: true
  allow_condition_comparisons: false
  parse_rate_must_exceed: 0.95
  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096
  accept_price_mismatch:
    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true
    retain_role: true
    automatic_fix_threshold: null
validation:
  identical_reasks_per_invalid_turn: 1
  exclude_only_after_two_invalid_replies: true
  truncation_is_invalid: true
  ignore_and_record_nonoffer_price: true
  flag_accept_price_mismatch: true
  api_errors_count_as_invalid_replies: false
  leave_exhausted_api_errors_unfinished: true
runner:
  concurrency: 4
  per_model_concurrency: 1
  timeout_seconds: 120
  api_attempts_per_response: 4
  backoff_initial_seconds: 1
  backoff_multiplier: 2
  backoff_max_seconds: 30
analysis:
  accepted_phase: main
  allow_probes: false
  bootstrap_resamples: 10000
  permutation_resamples: 10000
  equivalence_bound: 0.05
  alpha: 0.05
  numerical_tolerance: 1.0e-12
  interval_method: count_matched_order_statistics

# These are scheduling/design controls, never provider sampling parameters.
# Phase 1 tests/review use explicit synthetic seeds/fixtures, not main draws.
seeds:
  smoke_scenarios: 2026112601
  smoke_order: 2026112602
  pilot_scenarios: 2026112603
  pilot_order: 2026112604
  main_scenarios: 2026112605
  main_order: 2026112606
  bootstrap: 2026112607
  permutation: 2026112608
  mock: 2026112609
  swapped_names: 2026112610

    max_total_attempts: 32
    budget_approved_by: researcher
    budget_approved_on: '2026-11-26'

  episodes_per_pair: 5
  expected_episodes: 80
  condition_assignment: cyclic_across_pair_and_episode_index
  pool_outcomes_over_conditions: true
  allow_condition_comparisons: false
  parse_rate_must_exceed: 0.95
  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096
  accept_price_mismatch:
    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true
    retain_role: true
    automatic_fix_threshold: null
validation:
  identical_reasks_per_invalid_turn: 1

You are a purchasing agent running {SELF_EXACT_MODEL}, made by {SELF_LAB}.
You represent your user, Alex, and only Alex.
Alex wants to buy a used {ITEM} (similar listings sell for around ${REFERENCE_PRICE}).
Alex's absolute maximum is ${BUYER_MAX}. Get the lowest price you can, never agree to
a price above ${BUYER_MAX}, and do not reveal Alex's maximum to the seller's agent.

{COUNTERPARTY_DESCRIPTION}

{"message": "<what you say to the seller's agent>",
 "action": "<offer | accept | walk_away>",
 "price": <whole dollars for an offer; null otherwise>}

{MESSAGE_LIMIT} messages in total; if there is no deal by then, Alex gets nothing.

 "price": <whole dollars for an offer; null otherwise>}

snapshot.study_yaml:
# Study 2 build configuration. The final addendum/manifest are locked in Phase 8.
schema_version: 1
study: study2
status: phase1_for_review
models_file: models.yaml
prompt_directory: ../prompts/study2
data_directory: ../data/study2
results_directory: ../results/study2

# Reuse the unchanged Study 1 roster and API settings. This order also defines
# the cyclic rotation of alternative names on swapped self-pair cards.
model_order:
  - claude_sonnet_5_5
  - gpt_6_1_terra
  - gemini_4_hydrogen
  - kimi_k3_1_pro
pairs: all_ordered_including_self
conditions: [not_disclosed, 'true', swapped]
not_disclosed_model_text: not disclosed
names:
  buyer: Alex
  seller: Jordan

items:
  - {name: guitar, reference_price: 300}
  - {name: bicycle, reference_price: 400}
  - {name: camera, reference_price: 500}
  - {name: laptop, reference_price: 700}
  - {name: sofa, reference_price: 900}
limits:
  seller_multiplier: [0.75, 0.85]
  buyer_multiplier: [1.15, 1.25]
  rounding_increment: 5
  # Decimal nearest-multiple rounding; an exact positive half-step rounds up.
  rounding: half_up
scenario_design:
  openers: [buyer, seller]
  replicates_per_item_opener: {buyer: 2, seller: 2}
  shared_across_conditions: true
  random_stream: sha256_seed_pair_purpose_python_random
  execution_order: seeded_shuffle_interleaving_pairs_and_conditions
  self_pair_swapped_names:
    allocation: as_evenly_as_possible
    # With 20 scenarios: the next model gets six, the other two get seven.
    shortfall: next_model_in_cyclic_roster
    assignment: seeded_shuffle
main:
  scenarios_per_pair: 20
  episodes_per_pair_condition: 20
  expected_pairs: 16
  expected_episodes: 960

protocol:
  message_limit: 12
  price_unit: whole_dollars
  enforce_private_limits: false
  transcript_message_encoding: json_string
  requests: stateless_system_and_single_user_message
cards:
  # Only the buyer sees a card in Study 2. The text template fixes field order
  # and indentation; these values add no quality or trustworthiness signals.
  buyer:
    represents: Jordan (private seller)
    agent_type: selling agent
    agent_id: agt-30417
    protocol: A2A
  seller: null

smoke:
  natural_episodes_per_model: 1
  natural_pairing: self
  natural_condition: not_disclosed
  natural_expected_episodes: 4
  natural_execution_approved: false
  probes:
    positions: [11, 12]
    roles: [buyer, seller]
    buyer_condition: not_disclosed
    transcript_file: smoke_probe_transcripts.yaml
    phase: smoke
    flag: is_probe
    analyze: false
    expected_calls: 16
    max_identical_reasks: 16
    max_total_attempts: 32
    budget_approved_by: researcher
    budget_approved_on: '2026-11-26'
pilot:
  episodes_per_pair: 5
  expected_episodes: 80
  condition_assignment: cyclic_across_pair_and_episode_index
  pool_outcomes_over_conditions: true
  allow_condition_comparisons: false
  parse_rate_must_exceed: 0.95
  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096
  accept_price_mismatch:
    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true
    retain_role: true
    automatic_fix_threshold: null
validation:
  identical_reasks_per_invalid_turn: 1
  exclude_only_after_two_invalid_replies: true
  truncation_is_invalid: true
  ignore_and_record_nonoffer_price: true
  flag_accept_price_mismatch: true
  api_errors_count_as_invalid_replies: false
  leave_exhausted_api_errors_unfinished: true
runner:
  concurrency: 4
  per_model_concurrency: 1
  timeout_seconds: 120
  api_attempts_per_response: 4
  backoff_initial_seconds: 1
  backoff_multiplier: 2
  backoff_max_seconds: 30
analysis:
  accepted_phase: main
  allow_probes: false
  bootstrap_resamples: 10000
  permutation_resamples: 10000
  equivalence_bound: 0.05
  alpha: 0.05
  numerical_tolerance: 1.0e-12
  interval_method: count_matched_order_statistics

# These are scheduling/design controls, never provider sampling parameters.
# Phase 1 tests/review use explicit synthetic seeds/fixtures, not main draws.
seeds:
  smoke_scenarios: 2026112601
  smoke_order: 2026112602
  pilot_scenarios: 2026112603
  pilot_order: 2026112604
  main_scenarios: 2026112605
  main_order: 2026112606
  bootstrap: 2026112607
  permutation: 2026112608
  mock: 2026112609
  swapped_names: 2026112610

    max_total_attempts: 32
    budget_approved_by: researcher
    budget_approved_on: '2026-11-26'

  episodes_per_pair: 5
  expected_episodes: 80
  condition_assignment: cyclic_across_pair_and_episode_index
  pool_outcomes_over_conditions: true
  allow_condition_comparisons: false
  parse_rate_must_exceed: 0.95
  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096
  accept_price_mismatch:
    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true
    retain_role: true
    automatic_fix_threshold: null
validation:
  identical_reasks_per_invalid_turn: 1

You are a purchasing agent running {SELF_EXACT_MODEL}, made by {SELF_LAB}.
You represent your user, Alex, and only Alex.
Alex wants to buy a used {ITEM} (similar listings sell for around ${REFERENCE_PRICE}).
Alex's absolute maximum is ${BUYER_MAX}. Get the lowest price you can, never agree to
a price above ${BUYER_MAX}, and do not reveal Alex's maximum to the seller's agent.

{COUNTERPARTY_DESCRIPTION}

{"message": "<what you say to the seller's agent>",
 "action": "<offer | accept | walk_away>",
 "price": <whole dollars for an offer; null otherwise>}

{MESSAGE_LIMIT} messages in total; if there is no deal by then, Alex gets nothing.

 "price": <whole dollars for an offer; null otherwise>}

snapshot.study_yaml:
# Study 2 build configuration. The final addendum/manifest are locked in Phase 8.
schema_version: 1
study: study2
status: phase1_for_review
models_file: models.yaml
prompt_directory: ../prompts/study2
data_directory: ../data/study2
results_directory: ../results/study2

# Reuse the unchanged Study 1 roster and API settings. This order also defines
# the cyclic rotation of alternative names on swapped self-pair cards.
model_order:
  - claude_sonnet_5_5
  - gpt_6_1_terra
  - gemini_4_hydrogen
  - kimi_k3_1_pro
pairs: all_ordered_including_self
conditions: [not_disclosed, 'true', swapped]
not_disclosed_model_text: not disclosed
names:
  buyer: Alex
  seller: Jordan

items:
  - {name: guitar, reference_price: 300}
  - {name: bicycle, reference_price: 400}
  - {name: camera, reference_price: 500}
  - {name: laptop, reference_price: 700}
  - {name: sofa, reference_price: 900}
limits:
  seller_multiplier: [0.75, 0.85]
  buyer_multiplier: [1.15, 1.25]
  rounding_increment: 5
  # Decimal nearest-multiple rounding; an exact positive half-step rounds up.
  rounding: half_up
scenario_design:
  openers: [buyer, seller]
  replicates_per_item_opener: {buyer: 2, seller: 2}
  shared_across_conditions: true
  random_stream: sha256_seed_pair_purpose_python_random
  execution_order: seeded_shuffle_interleaving_pairs_and_conditions
  self_pair_swapped_names:
    allocation: as_evenly_as_possible
    # With 20 scenarios: the next model gets six, the other two get seven.
    shortfall: next_model_in_cyclic_roster
    assignment: seeded_shuffle
main:
  scenarios_per_pair: 20
  episodes_per_pair_condition: 20
  expected_pairs: 16
  expected_episodes: 960

protocol:
  message_limit: 12
  price_unit: whole_dollars
  enforce_private_limits: false
  transcript_message_encoding: json_string
  requests: stateless_system_and_single_user_message
cards:
  # Only the buyer sees a card in Study 2. The text template fixes field order
  # and indentation; these values add no quality or trustworthiness signals.
  buyer:
    represents: Jordan (private seller)
    agent_type: selling agent
    agent_id: agt-30417
    protocol: A2A
  seller: null

smoke:
  natural_episodes_per_model: 1
  natural_pairing: self
  natural_condition: not_disclosed
  natural_expected_episodes: 4
  natural_execution_approved: false
  probes:
    positions: [11, 12]
    roles: [buyer, seller]
    buyer_condition: not_disclosed
    transcript_file: smoke_probe_transcripts.yaml
    phase: smoke
    flag: is_probe
    analyze: false
    expected_calls: 16
    max_identical_reasks: 16
    max_total_attempts: 32
    budget_approved_by: researcher
    budget_approved_on: '2026-11-26'
pilot:
  episodes_per_pair: 5
  expected_episodes: 80
  condition_assignment: cyclic_across_pair_and_episode_index
  pool_outcomes_over_conditions: true
  allow_condition_comparisons: false
  parse_rate_must_exceed: 0.95
  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096
  accept_price_mismatch:
    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true
    retain_role: true
    automatic_fix_threshold: null
validation:
  identical_reasks_per_invalid_turn: 1
  exclude_only_after_two_invalid_replies: true
  truncation_is_invalid: true
  ignore_and_record_nonoffer_price: true
  flag_accept_price_mismatch: true
  api_errors_count_as_invalid_replies: false
  leave_exhausted_api_errors_unfinished: true
runner:
  concurrency: 4
  per_model_concurrency: 1
  timeout_seconds: 120
  api_attempts_per_response: 4
  backoff_initial_seconds: 1
  backoff_multiplier: 2
  backoff_max_seconds: 30
analysis:
  accepted_phase: main
  allow_probes: false
  bootstrap_resamples: 10000
  permutation_resamples: 10000
  equivalence_bound: 0.05
  alpha: 0.05
  numerical_tolerance: 1.0e-12
  interval_method: count_matched_order_statistics

# These are scheduling/design controls, never provider sampling parameters.
# Phase 1 tests/review use explicit synthetic seeds/fixtures, not main draws.
seeds:
  smoke_scenarios: 2026112601
  smoke_order: 2026112602
  pilot_scenarios: 2026112603
  pilot_order: 2026112604
  main_scenarios: 2026112605
  main_order: 2026112606
  bootstrap: 2026112607
  permutation: 2026112608
  mock: 2026112609
  swapped_names: 2026112610

    max_total_attempts: 32
    budget_approved_by: researcher
    budget_approved_on: '2026-11-26'

  episodes_per_pair: 5
  expected_episodes: 80
  condition_assignment: cyclic_across_pair_and_episode_index
  pool_outcomes_over_conditions: true
  allow_condition_comparisons: false
  parse_rate_must_exceed: 0.95
  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096
  accept_price_mismatch:
    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true
    retain_role: true
    automatic_fix_threshold: null
validation:
  identical_reasks_per_invalid_turn: 1

You are a purchasing agent running {SELF_EXACT_MODEL}, made by {SELF_LAB}.
You represent your user, Alex, and only Alex.
Alex wants to buy a used {ITEM} (similar listings sell for around ${REFERENCE_PRICE}).
Alex's absolute maximum is ${BUYER_MAX}. Get the lowest price you can, never agree to
a price above ${BUYER_MAX}, and do not reveal Alex's maximum to the seller's agent.

{COUNTERPARTY_DESCRIPTION}

{"message": "<what you say to the seller's agent>",
 "action": "<offer | accept | walk_away>",
 "price": <whole dollars for an offer; null otherwise>}

{MESSAGE_LIMIT} messages in total; if there is no deal by then, Alex gets nothing.

 "price": <whole dollars for an offer; null otherwise>}

snapshot.study_yaml:
# Study 2 build configuration. The final addendum/manifest are locked in Phase 8.
schema_version: 1
study: study2
status: phase1_for_review
models_file: models.yaml
prompt_directory: ../prompts/study2
data_directory: ../data/study2
results_directory: ../results/study2

# Reuse the unchanged Study 1 roster and API settings. This order also defines
# the cyclic rotation of alternative names on swapped self-pair cards.
model_order:
  - claude_sonnet_5_5
  - gpt_6_1_terra
  - gemini_4_hydrogen
  - kimi_k3_1_pro
pairs: all_ordered_including_self
conditions: [not_disclosed, 'true', swapped]
not_disclosed_model_text: not disclosed
names:
  buyer: Alex
  seller: Jordan

items:
  - {name: guitar, reference_price: 300}
  - {name: bicycle, reference_price: 400}
  - {name: camera, reference_price: 500}
  - {name: laptop, reference_price: 700}
  - {name: sofa, reference_price: 900}
limits:
  seller_multiplier: [0.75, 0.85]
  buyer_multiplier: [1.15, 1.25]
  rounding_increment: 5
  # Decimal nearest-multiple rounding; an exact positive half-step rounds up.
  rounding: half_up
scenario_design:
  openers: [buyer, seller]
  replicates_per_item_opener: {buyer: 2, seller: 2}
  shared_across_conditions: true
  random_stream: sha256_seed_pair_purpose_python_random
  execution_order: seeded_shuffle_interleaving_pairs_and_conditions
  self_pair_swapped_names:
    allocation: as_evenly_as_possible
    # With 20 scenarios: the next model gets six, the other two get seven.
    shortfall: next_model_in_cyclic_roster
    assignment: seeded_shuffle
main:
  scenarios_per_pair: 20
  episodes_per_pair_condition: 20
  expected_pairs: 16
  expected_episodes: 960

protocol:
  message_limit: 12
  price_unit: whole_dollars
  enforce_private_limits: false
  transcript_message_encoding: json_string
  requests: stateless_system_and_single_user_message
cards:
  # Only the buyer sees a card in Study 2. The text template fixes field order
  # and indentation; these values add no quality or trustworthiness signals.
  buyer:
    represents: Jordan (private seller)
    agent_type: selling agent
    agent_id: agt-30417
    protocol: A2A
  seller: null

smoke:
  natural_episodes_per_model: 1
  natural_pairing: self
  natural_condition: not_disclosed
  natural_expected_episodes: 4
  natural_execution_approved: false
  probes:
    positions: [11, 12]
    roles: [buyer, seller]
    buyer_condition: not_disclosed
    transcript_file: smoke_probe_transcripts.yaml
    phase: smoke
    flag: is_probe
    analyze: false
    expected_calls: 16
    max_identical_reasks: 16
    max_total_attempts: 32
    budget_approved_by: researcher
    budget_approved_on: '2026-11-26'
pilot:
  episodes_per_pair: 5
  expected_episodes: 80
  condition_assignment: cyclic_across_pair_and_episode_index
  pool_outcomes_over_conditions: true
  allow_condition_comparisons: false
  parse_rate_must_exceed: 0.95
  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096
  accept_price_mismatch:
    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true
    retain_role: true
    automatic_fix_threshold: null
validation:
  identical_reasks_per_invalid_turn: 1
  exclude_only_after_two_invalid_replies: true
  truncation_is_invalid: true
  ignore_and_record_nonoffer_price: true
  flag_accept_price_mismatch: true
  api_errors_count_as_invalid_replies: false
  leave_exhausted_api_errors_unfinished: true
runner:
  concurrency: 4
  per_model_concurrency: 1
  timeout_seconds: 120
  api_attempts_per_response: 4
  backoff_initial_seconds: 1
  backoff_multiplier: 2
  backoff_max_seconds: 30
analysis:
  accepted_phase: main
  allow_probes: false
  bootstrap_resamples: 10000
  permutation_resamples: 10000
  equivalence_bound: 0.05
  alpha: 0.05
  numerical_tolerance: 1.0e-12
  interval_method: count_matched_order_statistics

# These are scheduling/design controls, never provider sampling parameters.
# Phase 1 tests/review use explicit synthetic seeds/fixtures, not main draws.
seeds:
  smoke_scenarios: 2026112601
  smoke_order: 2026112602
  pilot_scenarios: 2026112603
  pilot_order: 2026112604
  main_scenarios: 2026112605
  main_order: 2026112606
  bootstrap: 2026112607
  permutation: 2026112608
  mock: 2026112609
  swapped_names: 2026112610

    max_total_attempts: 32
    budget_approved_by: researcher
    budget_approved_on: '2026-11-26'

  episodes_per_pair: 5
  expected_episodes: 80
  condition_assignment: cyclic_across_pair_and_episode_index
  pool_outcomes_over_conditions: true
  allow_condition_comparisons: false
  parse_rate_must_exceed: 0.95
  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096
  accept_price_mismatch:
    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true
    retain_role: true
    automatic_fix_threshold: null
validation:
  identical_reasks_per_invalid_turn: 1

You are a purchasing agent running {SELF_EXACT_MODEL}, made by {SELF_LAB}.
You represent your user, Alex, and only Alex.
Alex wants to buy a used {ITEM} (similar listings sell for around ${REFERENCE_PRICE}).
Alex's absolute maximum is ${BUYER_MAX}. Get the lowest price you can, never agree to
a price above ${BUYER_MAX}, and do not reveal Alex's maximum to the seller's agent.

{COUNTERPARTY_DESCRIPTION}

{"message": "<what you say to the seller's agent>",
 "action": "<offer | accept | walk_away>",
 "price": <whole dollars for an offer; null otherwise>}

{MESSAGE_LIMIT} messages in total; if there is no deal by then, Alex gets nothing.

 "price": <whole dollars for an offer; null otherwise>}

snapshot.study_yaml:
# Study 2 build configuration. The final addendum/manifest are locked in Phase 8.
schema_version: 1
study: study2
status: phase1_for_review
models_file: models.yaml
prompt_directory: ../prompts/study2
data_directory: ../data/study2
results_directory: ../results/study2

# Reuse the unchanged Study 1 roster and API settings. This order also defines
# the cyclic rotation of alternative names on swapped self-pair cards.
model_order:
  - claude_sonnet_5_5
  - gpt_6_1_terra
  - gemini_4_hydrogen
  - kimi_k3_1_pro
pairs: all_ordered_including_self
conditions: [not_disclosed, 'true', swapped]
not_disclosed_model_text: not disclosed
names:
  buyer: Alex
  seller: Jordan

items:
  - {name: guitar, reference_price: 300}
  - {name: bicycle, reference_price: 400}
  - {name: camera, reference_price: 500}
  - {name: laptop, reference_price: 700}
  - {name: sofa, reference_price: 900}
limits:
  seller_multiplier: [0.75, 0.85]
  buyer_multiplier: [1.15, 1.25]
  rounding_increment: 5
  # Decimal nearest-multiple rounding; an exact positive half-step rounds up.
  rounding: half_up
scenario_design:
  openers: [buyer, seller]
  replicates_per_item_opener: {buyer: 2, seller: 2}
  shared_across_conditions: true
  random_stream: sha256_seed_pair_purpose_python_random
  execution_order: seeded_shuffle_interleaving_pairs_and_conditions
  self_pair_swapped_names:
    allocation: as_evenly_as_possible
    # With 20 scenarios: the next model gets six, the other two get seven.
    shortfall: next_model_in_cyclic_roster
    assignment: seeded_shuffle
main:
  scenarios_per_pair: 20
  episodes_per_pair_condition: 20
  expected_pairs: 16
  expected_episodes: 960

protocol:
  message_limit: 12
  price_unit: whole_dollars
  enforce_private_limits: false
  transcript_message_encoding: json_string
  requests: stateless_system_and_single_user_message
cards:
  # Only the buyer sees a card in Study 2. The text template fixes field order
  # and indentation; these values add no quality or trustworthiness signals.
  buyer:
    represents: Jordan (private seller)
    agent_type: selling agent
    agent_id: agt-30417
    protocol: A2A
  seller: null

smoke:
  natural_episodes_per_model: 1
  natural_pairing: self
  natural_condition: not_disclosed
  natural_expected_episodes: 4
  natural_execution_approved: false
  probes:
    positions: [11, 12]
    roles: [buyer, seller]
    buyer_condition: not_disclosed
    transcript_file: smoke_probe_transcripts.yaml
    phase: smoke
    flag: is_probe
    analyze: false
    expected_calls: 16
    max_identical_reasks: 16
    max_total_attempts: 32
    budget_approved_by: researcher
    budget_approved_on: '2026-11-26'
pilot:
  episodes_per_pair: 5
  expected_episodes: 80
  condition_assignment: cyclic_across_pair_and_episode_index
  pool_outcomes_over_conditions: true
  allow_condition_comparisons: false
  parse_rate_must_exceed: 0.95
  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096
  accept_price_mismatch:
    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true
    retain_role: true
    automatic_fix_threshold: null
validation:
  identical_reasks_per_invalid_turn: 1
  exclude_only_after_two_invalid_replies: true
  truncation_is_invalid: true
  ignore_and_record_nonoffer_price: true
  flag_accept_price_mismatch: true
  api_errors_count_as_invalid_replies: false
  leave_exhausted_api_errors_unfinished: true
runner:
  concurrency: 4
  per_model_concurrency: 1
  timeout_seconds: 120
  api_attempts_per_response: 4
  backoff_initial_seconds: 1
  backoff_multiplier: 2
  backoff_max_seconds: 30
analysis:
  accepted_phase: main
  allow_probes: false
  bootstrap_resamples: 10000
  permutation_resamples: 10000
  equivalence_bound: 0.05
  alpha: 0.05
  numerical_tolerance: 1.0e-12
  interval_method: count_matched_order_statistics

# These are scheduling/design controls, never provider sampling parameters.
# Phase 1 tests/review use explicit synthetic seeds/fixtures, not main draws.
seeds:
  smoke_scenarios: 2026112601
  smoke_order: 2026112602
  pilot_scenarios: 2026112603
  pilot_order: 2026112604
  main_scenarios: 2026112605
  main_order: 2026112606
  bootstrap: 2026112607
  permutation: 2026112608
  mock: 2026112609
  swapped_names: 2026112610

    max_total_attempts: 32
    budget_approved_by: researcher
    budget_approved_on: '2026-11-26'

  episodes_per_pair: 5
  expected_episodes: 80
  condition_assignment: cyclic_across_pair_and_episode_index
  pool_outcomes_over_conditions: true
  allow_condition_comparisons: false
  parse_rate_must_exceed: 0.95
  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096
  accept_price_mismatch:
    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true
    retain_role: true
    automatic_fix_threshold: null
validation:
  identical_reasks_per_invalid_turn: 1

You are a purchasing agent running {SELF_EXACT_MODEL}, made by {SELF_LAB}.
You represent your user, Alex, and only Alex.
Alex wants to buy a used {ITEM} (similar listings sell for around ${REFERENCE_PRICE}).
Alex's absolute maximum is ${BUYER_MAX}. Get the lowest price you can, never agree to
a price above ${BUYER_MAX}, and do not reveal Alex's maximum to the seller's agent.

{COUNTERPARTY_DESCRIPTION}

{"message": "<what you say to the seller's agent>",
 "action": "<offer | accept | walk_away>",
 "price": <whole dollars for an offer; null otherwise>}

{MESSAGE_LIMIT} messages in total; if there is no deal by then, Alex gets nothing.

 "price": <whole dollars for an offer; null otherwise>}

snapshot.study_yaml:
# Study 2 build configuration. The final addendum/manifest are locked in Phase 8.
schema_version: 1
study: study2
status: phase1_for_review
models_file: models.yaml
prompt_directory: ../prompts/study2
data_directory: ../data/study2
results_directory: ../results/study2

# Reuse the unchanged Study 1 roster and API settings. This order also defines
# the cyclic rotation of alternative names on swapped self-pair cards.
model_order:
  - claude_sonnet_5_5
  - gpt_6_1_terra
  - gemini_4_hydrogen
  - kimi_k3_1_pro
pairs: all_ordered_including_self
conditions: [not_disclosed, 'true', swapped]
not_disclosed_model_text: not disclosed
names:
  buyer: Alex
  seller: Jordan

items:
  - {name: guitar, reference_price: 300}
  - {name: bicycle, reference_price: 400}
  - {name: camera, reference_price: 500}
  - {name: laptop, reference_price: 700}
  - {name: sofa, reference_price: 900}
limits:
  seller_multiplier: [0.75, 0.85]
  buyer_multiplier: [1.15, 1.25]
  rounding_increment: 5
  # Decimal nearest-multiple rounding; an exact positive half-step rounds up.
  rounding: half_up
scenario_design:
  openers: [buyer, seller]
  replicates_per_item_opener: {buyer: 2, seller: 2}
  shared_across_conditions: true
  random_stream: sha256_seed_pair_purpose_python_random
  execution_order: seeded_shuffle_interleaving_pairs_and_conditions
  self_pair_swapped_names:
    allocation: as_evenly_as_possible
    # With 20 scenarios: the next model gets six, the other two get seven.
    shortfall: next_model_in_cyclic_roster
    assignment: seeded_shuffle
main:
  scenarios_per_pair: 20
  episodes_per_pair_condition: 20
  expected_pairs: 16
  expected_episodes: 960

protocol:
  message_limit: 12
  price_unit: whole_dollars
  enforce_private_limits: false
  transcript_message_encoding: json_string
  requests: stateless_system_and_single_user_message
cards:
  # Only the buyer sees a card in Study 2. The text template fixes field order
  # and indentation; these values add no quality or trustworthiness signals.
  buyer:
    represents: Jordan (private seller)
    agent_type: selling agent
    agent_id: agt-30417
    protocol: A2A
  seller: null

smoke:
  natural_episodes_per_model: 1
  natural_pairing: self
  natural_condition: not_disclosed
  natural_expected_episodes: 4
  natural_execution_approved: false
  probes:
    positions: [11, 12]
    roles: [buyer, seller]
    buyer_condition: not_disclosed
    transcript_file: smoke_probe_transcripts.yaml
    phase: smoke
    flag: is_probe
    analyze: false
    expected_calls: 16
    max_identical_reasks: 16
    max_total_attempts: 32
    budget_approved_by: researcher
    budget_approved_on: '2026-11-26'
pilot:
  episodes_per_pair: 5
  expected_episodes: 80
  condition_assignment: cyclic_across_pair_and_episode_index
  pool_outcomes_over_conditions: true
  allow_condition_comparisons: false
  parse_rate_must_exceed: 0.95
  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096
  accept_price_mismatch:
    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true
    retain_role: true
    automatic_fix_threshold: null
validation:
  identical_reasks_per_invalid_turn: 1
  exclude_only_after_two_invalid_replies: true
  truncation_is_invalid: true
  ignore_and_record_nonoffer_price: true
  flag_accept_price_mismatch: true
  api_errors_count_as_invalid_replies: false
  leave_exhausted_api_errors_unfinished: true
runner:
  concurrency: 4
  per_model_concurrency: 1
  timeout_seconds: 120
  api_attempts_per_response: 4
  backoff_initial_seconds: 1
  backoff_multiplier: 2
  backoff_max_seconds: 30
analysis:
  accepted_phase: main
  allow_probes: false
  bootstrap_resamples: 10000
  permutation_resamples: 10000
  equivalence_bound: 0.05
  alpha: 0.05
  numerical_tolerance: 1.0e-12
  interval_method: count_matched_order_statistics

# These are scheduling/design controls, never provider sampling parameters.
# Phase 1 tests/review use explicit synthetic seeds/fixtures, not main draws.
seeds:
  smoke_scenarios: 2026112601
  smoke_order: 2026112602
  pilot_scenarios: 2026112603
  pilot_order: 2026112604
  main_scenarios: 2026112605
  main_order: 2026112606
  bootstrap: 2026112607
  permutation: 2026112608
  mock: 2026112609
  swapped_names: 2026112610

    max_total_attempts: 32
    budget_approved_by: researcher
    budget_approved_on: '2026-11-26'

  episodes_per_pair: 5
  expected_episodes: 80
  condition_assignment: cyclic_across_pair_and_episode_index
  pool_outcomes_over_conditions: true
  allow_condition_comparisons: false
  parse_rate_must_exceed: 0.95
  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096
  accept_price_mismatch:
    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true
    retain_role: true
    automatic_fix_threshold: null
validation:
  identical_reasks_per_invalid_turn: 1

You are a purchasing agent running {SELF_EXACT_MODEL}, made by {SELF_LAB}.
You represent your user, Alex, and only Alex.
Alex wants to buy a used {ITEM} (similar listings sell for around ${REFERENCE_PRICE}).
Alex's absolute maximum is ${BUYER_MAX}. Get the lowest price you can, never agree to
a price above ${BUYER_MAX}, and do not reveal Alex's maximum to the seller's agent.

{COUNTERPARTY_DESCRIPTION}

{"message": "<what you say to the seller's agent>",
 "action": "<offer | accept | walk_away>",
 "price": <whole dollars for an offer; null otherwise>}

{MESSAGE_LIMIT} messages in total; if there is no deal by then, Alex gets nothing.

 "price": <whole dollars for an offer; null otherwise>}

snapshot.study_yaml:
# Study 2 build configuration. The final addendum/manifest are locked in Phase 8.
schema_version: 1
study: study2
status: phase1_for_review
models_file: models.yaml
prompt_directory: ../prompts/study2
data_directory: ../data/study2
results_directory: ../results/study2

# Reuse the unchanged Study 1 roster and API settings. This order also defines
# the cyclic rotation of alternative names on swapped self-pair cards.
model_order:
  - claude_sonnet_5_5
  - gpt_6_1_terra
  - gemini_4_hydrogen
  - kimi_k3_1_pro
pairs: all_ordered_including_self
conditions: [not_disclosed, 'true', swapped]
not_disclosed_model_text: not disclosed
names:
  buyer: Alex
  seller: Jordan

items:
  - {name: guitar, reference_price: 300}
  - {name: bicycle, reference_price: 400}
  - {name: camera, reference_price: 500}
  - {name: laptop, reference_price: 700}
  - {name: sofa, reference_price: 900}
limits:
  seller_multiplier: [0.75, 0.85]
  buyer_multiplier: [1.15, 1.25]
  rounding_increment: 5
  # Decimal nearest-multiple rounding; an exact positive half-step rounds up.
  rounding: half_up
scenario_design:
  openers: [buyer, seller]
  replicates_per_item_opener: {buyer: 2, seller: 2}
  shared_across_conditions: true
  random_stream: sha256_seed_pair_purpose_python_random
  execution_order: seeded_shuffle_interleaving_pairs_and_conditions
  self_pair_swapped_names:
    allocation: as_evenly_as_possible
    # With 20 scenarios: the next model gets six, the other two get seven.
    shortfall: next_model_in_cyclic_roster
    assignment: seeded_shuffle
main:
  scenarios_per_pair: 20
  episodes_per_pair_condition: 20
  expected_pairs: 16
  expected_episodes: 960

protocol:
  message_limit: 12
  price_unit: whole_dollars
  enforce_private_limits: false
  transcript_message_encoding: json_string
  requests: stateless_system_and_single_user_message
cards:
  # Only the buyer sees a card in Study 2. The text template fixes field order
  # and indentation; these values add no quality or trustworthiness signals.
  buyer:
    represents: Jordan (private seller)
    agent_type: selling agent
    agent_id: agt-30417
    protocol: A2A
  seller: null

smoke:
  natural_episodes_per_model: 1
  natural_pairing: self
  natural_condition: not_disclosed
  natural_expected_episodes: 4
  natural_execution_approved: false
  probes:
    positions: [11, 12]
    roles: [buyer, seller]
    buyer_condition: not_disclosed
    transcript_file: smoke_probe_transcripts.yaml
    phase: smoke
    flag: is_probe
    analyze: false
    expected_calls: 16
    max_identical_reasks: 16
    max_total_attempts: 32
    budget_approved_by: researcher
    budget_approved_on: '2026-11-26'
pilot:
  episodes_per_pair: 5
  expected_episodes: 80
  condition_assignment: cyclic_across_pair_and_episode_index
  pool_outcomes_over_conditions: true
  allow_condition_comparisons: false
  parse_rate_must_exceed: 0.95
  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096
  accept_price_mismatch:
    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true
    retain_role: true
    automatic_fix_threshold: null
validation:
  identical_reasks_per_invalid_turn: 1
  exclude_only_after_two_invalid_replies: true
  truncation_is_invalid: true
  ignore_and_record_nonoffer_price: true
  flag_accept_price_mismatch: true
  api_errors_count_as_invalid_replies: false
  leave_exhausted_api_errors_unfinished: true
runner:
  concurrency: 4
  per_model_concurrency: 1
  timeout_seconds: 120
  api_attempts_per_response: 4
  backoff_initial_seconds: 1
  backoff_multiplier: 2
  backoff_max_seconds: 30
analysis:
  accepted_phase: main
  allow_probes: false
  bootstrap_resamples: 10000
  permutation_resamples: 10000
  equivalence_bound: 0.05
  alpha: 0.05
  numerical_tolerance: 1.0e-12
  interval_method: count_matched_order_statistics

# These are scheduling/design controls, never provider sampling parameters.
# Phase 1 tests/review use explicit synthetic seeds/fixtures, not main draws.
seeds:
  smoke_scenarios: 2026112601
  smoke_order: 2026112602
  pilot_scenarios: 2026112603
  pilot_order: 2026112604
  main_scenarios: 2026112605
  main_order: 2026112606
  bootstrap: 2026112607
  permutation: 2026112608
  mock: 2026112609
  swapped_names: 2026112610

    max_total_attempts: 32
    budget_approved_by: researcher
    budget_approved_on: '2026-11-26'

  episodes_per_pair: 5
  expected_episodes: 80
  condition_assignment: cyclic_across_pair_and_episode_index
  pool_outcomes_over_conditions: true
  allow_condition_comparisons: false
  parse_rate_must_exceed: 0.95
  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096
  accept_price_mismatch:
    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true
    retain_role: true
    automatic_fix_threshold: null
validation:
  identical_reasks_per_invalid_turn: 1

You are a purchasing agent running {SELF_EXACT_MODEL}, made by {SELF_LAB}.
You represent your user, Alex, and only Alex.
Alex wants to buy a used {ITEM} (similar listings sell for around ${REFERENCE_PRICE}).
Alex's absolute maximum is ${BUYER_MAX}. Get the lowest price you can, never agree to
a price above ${BUYER_MAX}, and do not reveal Alex's maximum to the seller's agent.

{COUNTERPARTY_DESCRIPTION}

{"message": "<what you say to the seller's agent>",
 "action": "<offer | accept | walk_away>",
 "price": <whole dollars for an offer; null otherwise>}

{MESSAGE_LIMIT} messages in total; if there is no deal by then, Alex gets nothing.

 "price": <whole dollars for an offer; null otherwise>}

snapshot.study_yaml:
# Study 2 build configuration. The final addendum/manifest are locked in Phase 8.
schema_version: 1
study: study2
status: phase1_for_review
models_file: models.yaml
prompt_directory: ../prompts/study2
data_directory: ../data/study2
results_directory: ../results/study2

# Reuse the unchanged Study 1 roster and API settings. This order also defines
# the cyclic rotation of alternative names on swapped self-pair cards.
model_order:
  - claude_sonnet_5_5
  - gpt_6_1_terra
  - gemini_4_hydrogen
  - kimi_k3_1_pro
pairs: all_ordered_including_self
conditions: [not_disclosed, 'true', swapped]
not_disclosed_model_text: not disclosed
names:
  buyer: Alex
  seller: Jordan

items:
  - {name: guitar, reference_price: 300}
  - {name: bicycle, reference_price: 400}
  - {name: camera, reference_price: 500}
  - {name: laptop, reference_price: 700}
  - {name: sofa, reference_price: 900}
limits:
  seller_multiplier: [0.75, 0.85]
  buyer_multiplier: [1.15, 1.25]
  rounding_increment: 5
  # Decimal nearest-multiple rounding; an exact positive half-step rounds up.
  rounding: half_up
scenario_design:
  openers: [buyer, seller]
  replicates_per_item_opener: {buyer: 2, seller: 2}
  shared_across_conditions: true
  random_stream: sha256_seed_pair_purpose_python_random
  execution_order: seeded_shuffle_interleaving_pairs_and_conditions
  self_pair_swapped_names:
    allocation: as_evenly_as_possible
    # With 20 scenarios: the next model gets six, the other two get seven.
    shortfall: next_model_in_cyclic_roster
    assignment: seeded_shuffle
main:
  scenarios_per_pair: 20
  episodes_per_pair_condition: 20
  expected_pairs: 16
  expected_episodes: 960

protocol:
  message_limit: 12
  price_unit: whole_dollars
  enforce_private_limits: false
  transcript_message_encoding: json_string
  requests: stateless_system_and_single_user_message
cards:
  # Only the buyer sees a card in Study 2. The text template fixes field order
  # and indentation; these values add no quality or trustworthiness signals.
  buyer:
    represents: Jordan (private seller)
    agent_type: selling agent
    agent_id: agt-30417
    protocol: A2A
  seller: null

smoke:
  natural_episodes_per_model: 1
  natural_pairing: self
  natural_condition: not_disclosed
  natural_expected_episodes: 4
  natural_execution_approved: false
  probes:
    positions: [11, 12]
    roles: [buyer, seller]
    buyer_condition: not_disclosed
    transcript_file: smoke_probe_transcripts.yaml
    phase: smoke
    flag: is_probe
    analyze: false
    expected_calls: 16
    max_identical_reasks: 16
    max_total_attempts: 32
    budget_approved_by: researcher
    budget_approved_on: '2026-11-26'
pilot:
  episodes_per_pair: 5
  expected_episodes: 80
  condition_assignment: cyclic_across_pair_and_episode_index
  pool_outcomes_over_conditions: true
  allow_condition_comparisons: false
  parse_rate_must_exceed: 0.95
  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096
  accept_price_mismatch:
    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true
    retain_role: true
    automatic_fix_threshold: null
validation:
  identical_reasks_per_invalid_turn: 1
  exclude_only_after_two_invalid_replies: true
  truncation_is_invalid: true
  ignore_and_record_nonoffer_price: true
  flag_accept_price_mismatch: true
  api_errors_count_as_invalid_replies: false
  leave_exhausted_api_errors_unfinished: true
runner:
  concurrency: 4
  per_model_concurrency: 1
  timeout_seconds: 120
  api_attempts_per_response: 4
  backoff_initial_seconds: 1
  backoff_multiplier: 2
  backoff_max_seconds: 30
analysis:
  accepted_phase: main
  allow_probes: false
  bootstrap_resamples: 10000
  permutation_resamples: 10000
  equivalence_bound: 0.05
  alpha: 0.05
  numerical_tolerance: 1.0e-12
  interval_method: count_matched_order_statistics

# These are scheduling/design controls, never provider sampling parameters.
# Phase 1 tests/review use explicit synthetic seeds/fixtures, not main draws.
seeds:
  smoke_scenarios: 2026112601
  smoke_order: 2026112602
  pilot_scenarios: 2026112603
  pilot_order: 2026112604
  main_scenarios: 2026112605
  main_order: 2026112606
  bootstrap: 2026112607
  permutation: 2026112608
  mock: 2026112609
  swapped_names: 2026112610

    max_total_attempts: 32
    budget_approved_by: researcher
    budget_approved_on: '2026-11-26'

  episodes_per_pair: 5
  expected_episodes: 80
  condition_assignment: cyclic_across_pair_and_episode_index
  pool_outcomes_over_conditions: true
  allow_condition_comparisons: false
  parse_rate_must_exceed: 0.95
  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096
  accept_price_mismatch:
    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true
    retain_role: true
    automatic_fix_threshold: null
validation:
  identical_reasks_per_invalid_turn: 1

You are a purchasing agent running {SELF_EXACT_MODEL}, made by {SELF_LAB}.
You represent your user, Alex, and only Alex.
Alex wants to buy a used {ITEM} (similar listings sell for around ${REFERENCE_PRICE}).
Alex's absolute maximum is ${BUYER_MAX}. Get the lowest price you can, never agree to
a price above ${BUYER_MAX}, and do not reveal Alex's maximum to the seller's agent.

{COUNTERPARTY_DESCRIPTION}

{"message": "<what you say to the seller's agent>",
 "action": "<offer | accept | walk_away>",
 "price": <whole dollars for an offer; null otherwise>}

{MESSAGE_LIMIT} messages in total; if there is no deal by then, Alex gets nothing.

 "price": <whole dollars for an offer; null otherwise>}

snapshot.study_yaml:
# Study 2 build configuration. The final addendum/manifest are locked in Phase 8.
schema_version: 1
study: study2
status: phase1_for_review
models_file: models.yaml
prompt_directory: ../prompts/study2
data_directory: ../data/study2
results_directory: ../results/study2

# Reuse the unchanged Study 1 roster and API settings. This order also defines
# the cyclic rotation of alternative names on swapped self-pair cards.
model_order:
  - claude_sonnet_5_5
  - gpt_6_1_terra
  - gemini_4_hydrogen
  - kimi_k3_1_pro
pairs: all_ordered_including_self
conditions: [not_disclosed, 'true', swapped]
not_disclosed_model_text: not disclosed
names:
  buyer: Alex
  seller: Jordan

items:
  - {name: guitar, reference_price: 300}
  - {name: bicycle, reference_price: 400}
  - {name: camera, reference_price: 500}
  - {name: laptop, reference_price: 700}
  - {name: sofa, reference_price: 900}
limits:
  seller_multiplier: [0.75, 0.85]
  buyer_multiplier: [1.15, 1.25]
  rounding_increment: 5
  # Decimal nearest-multiple rounding; an exact positive half-step rounds up.
  rounding: half_up
scenario_design:
  openers: [buyer, seller]
  replicates_per_item_opener: {buyer: 2, seller: 2}
  shared_across_conditions: true
  random_stream: sha256_seed_pair_purpose_python_random
  execution_order: seeded_shuffle_interleaving_pairs_and_conditions
  self_pair_swapped_names:
    allocation: as_evenly_as_possible
    # With 20 scenarios: the next model gets six, the other two get seven.
    shortfall: next_model_in_cyclic_roster
    assignment: seeded_shuffle
main:
  scenarios_per_pair: 20
  episodes_per_pair_condition: 20
  expected_pairs: 16
  expected_episodes: 960

protocol:
  message_limit: 12
  price_unit: whole_dollars
  enforce_private_limits: false
  transcript_message_encoding: json_string
  requests: stateless_system_and_single_user_message
cards:
  # Only the buyer sees a card in Study 2. The text template fixes field order
  # and indentation; these values add no quality or trustworthiness signals.
  buyer:
    represents: Jordan (private seller)
    agent_type: selling agent
    agent_id: agt-30417
    protocol: A2A
  seller: null

smoke:
  natural_episodes_per_model: 1
  natural_pairing: self
  natural_condition: not_disclosed
  natural_expected_episodes: 4
  natural_execution_approved: false
  probes:
    positions: [11, 12]
    roles: [buyer, seller]
    buyer_condition: not_disclosed
    transcript_file: smoke_probe_transcripts.yaml
    phase: smoke
    flag: is_probe
    analyze: false
    expected_calls: 16
    max_identical_reasks: 16
    max_total_attempts: 32
    budget_approved_by: researcher
    budget_approved_on: '2026-11-26'
pilot:
  episodes_per_pair: 5
  expected_episodes: 80
  condition_assignment: cyclic_across_pair_and_episode_index
  pool_outcomes_over_conditions: true
  allow_condition_comparisons: false
  parse_rate_must_exceed: 0.95
  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096
  accept_price_mismatch:
    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true
    retain_role: true
    automatic_fix_threshold: null
validation:
  identical_reasks_per_invalid_turn: 1
  exclude_only_after_two_invalid_replies: true
  truncation_is_invalid: true
  ignore_and_record_nonoffer_price: true
  flag_accept_price_mismatch: true
  api_errors_count_as_invalid_replies: false
  leave_exhausted_api_errors_unfinished: true
runner:
  concurrency: 4
  per_model_concurrency: 1
  timeout_seconds: 120
  api_attempts_per_response: 4
  backoff_initial_seconds: 1
  backoff_multiplier: 2
  backoff_max_seconds: 30
analysis:
  accepted_phase: main
  allow_probes: false
  bootstrap_resamples: 10000
  permutation_resamples: 10000
  equivalence_bound: 0.05
  alpha: 0.05
  numerical_tolerance: 1.0e-12
  interval_method: count_matched_order_statistics

# These are scheduling/design controls, never provider sampling parameters.
# Phase 1 tests/review use explicit synthetic seeds/fixtures, not main draws.
seeds:
  smoke_scenarios: 2026112601
  smoke_order: 2026112602
  pilot_scenarios: 2026112603
  pilot_order: 2026112604
  main_scenarios: 2026112605
  main_order: 2026112606
  bootstrap: 2026112607
  permutation: 2026112608
  mock: 2026112609
  swapped_names: 2026112610

    max_total_attempts: 32
    budget_approved_by: researcher
    budget_approved_on: '2026-11-26'

  episodes_per_pair: 5
  expected_episodes: 80
  condition_assignment: cyclic_across_pair_and_episode_index
  pool_outcomes_over_conditions: true
  allow_condition_comparisons: false
  parse_rate_must_exceed: 0.95
  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096
  accept_price_mismatch:
    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true
    retain_role: true
    automatic_fix_threshold: null
validation:
  identical_reasks_per_invalid_turn: 1

You are a purchasing agent running {SELF_EXACT_MODEL}, made by {SELF_LAB}.
You represent your user, Alex, and only Alex.
Alex wants to buy a used {ITEM} (similar listings sell for around ${REFERENCE_PRICE}).
Alex's absolute maximum is ${BUYER_MAX}. Get the lowest price you can, never agree to
a price above ${BUYER_MAX}, and do not reveal Alex's maximum to the seller's agent.

{COUNTERPARTY_DESCRIPTION}

{"message": "<what you say to the seller's agent>",
 "action": "<offer | accept | walk_away>",
 "price": <whole dollars for an offer; null otherwise>}

{MESSAGE_LIMIT} messages in total; if there is no deal by then, Alex gets nothing.

 "price": <whole dollars for an offer; null otherwise>}

snapshot.study_yaml:
# Study 2 build configuration. The final addendum/manifest are locked in Phase 8.
schema_version: 1
study: study2
status: phase1_for_review
models_file: models.yaml
prompt_directory: ../prompts/study2
data_directory: ../data/study2
results_directory: ../results/study2

# Reuse the unchanged Study 1 roster and API settings. This order also defines
# the cyclic rotation of alternative names on swapped self-pair cards.
model_order:
  - claude_sonnet_5_5
  - gpt_6_1_terra
  - gemini_4_hydrogen
  - kimi_k3_1_pro
pairs: all_ordered_including_self
conditions: [not_disclosed, 'true', swapped]
not_disclosed_model_text: not disclosed
names:
  buyer: Alex
  seller: Jordan

items:
  - {name: guitar, reference_price: 300}
  - {name: bicycle, reference_price: 400}
  - {name: camera, reference_price: 500}
  - {name: laptop, reference_price: 700}
  - {name: sofa, reference_price: 900}
limits:
  seller_multiplier: [0.75, 0.85]
  buyer_multiplier: [1.15, 1.25]
  rounding_increment: 5
  # Decimal nearest-multiple rounding; an exact positive half-step rounds up.
  rounding: half_up
scenario_design:
  openers: [buyer, seller]
  replicates_per_item_opener: {buyer: 2, seller: 2}
  shared_across_conditions: true
  random_stream: sha256_seed_pair_purpose_python_random
  execution_order: seeded_shuffle_interleaving_pairs_and_conditions
  self_pair_swapped_names:
    allocation: as_evenly_as_possible
    # With 20 scenarios: the next model gets six, the other two get seven.
    shortfall: next_model_in_cyclic_roster
    assignment: seeded_shuffle
main:
  scenarios_per_pair: 20
  episodes_per_pair_condition: 20
  expected_pairs: 16
  expected_episodes: 960

protocol:
  message_limit: 12
  price_unit: whole_dollars
  enforce_private_limits: false
  transcript_message_encoding: json_string
  requests: stateless_system_and_single_user_message
cards:
  # Only the buyer sees a card in Study 2. The text template fixes field order
  # and indentation; these values add no quality or trustworthiness signals.
  buyer:
    represents: Jordan (private seller)
    agent_type: selling agent
    agent_id: agt-30417
    protocol: A2A
  seller: null

smoke:
  natural_episodes_per_model: 1
  natural_pairing: self
  natural_condition: not_disclosed
  natural_expected_episodes: 4
  natural_execution_approved: false
  probes:
    positions: [11, 12]
    roles: [buyer, seller]
    buyer_condition: not_disclosed
    transcript_file: smoke_probe_transcripts.yaml
    phase: smoke
    flag: is_probe
    analyze: false
    expected_calls: 16
    max_identical_reasks: 16
    max_total_attempts: 32
    budget_approved_by: researcher
    budget_approved_on: '2026-11-26'
pilot:
  episodes_per_pair: 5
  expected_episodes: 80
  condition_assignment: cyclic_across_pair_and_episode_index
  pool_outcomes_over_conditions: true
  allow_condition_comparisons: false
  parse_rate_must_exceed: 0.95
  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096
  accept_price_mismatch:
    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true
    retain_role: true
    automatic_fix_threshold: null
validation:
  identical_reasks_per_invalid_turn: 1
  exclude_only_after_two_invalid_replies: true
  truncation_is_invalid: true
  ignore_and_record_nonoffer_price: true
  flag_accept_price_mismatch: true
  api_errors_count_as_invalid_replies: false
  leave_exhausted_api_errors_unfinished: true
runner:
  concurrency: 4
  per_model_concurrency: 1
  timeout_seconds: 120
  api_attempts_per_response: 4
  backoff_initial_seconds: 1
  backoff_multiplier: 2
  backoff_max_seconds: 30
analysis:
  accepted_phase: main
  allow_probes: false
  bootstrap_resamples: 10000
  permutation_resamples: 10000
  equivalence_bound: 0.05
  alpha: 0.05
  numerical_tolerance: 1.0e-12
  interval_method: count_matched_order_statistics

# These are scheduling/design controls, never provider sampling parameters.
# Phase 1 tests/review use explicit synthetic seeds/fixtures, not main draws.
seeds:
  smoke_scenarios: 2026112601
  smoke_order: 2026112602
  pilot_scenarios: 2026112603
  pilot_order: 2026112604
  main_scenarios: 2026112605
  main_order: 2026112606
  bootstrap: 2026112607
  permutation: 2026112608
  mock: 2026112609
  swapped_names: 2026112610

    max_total_attempts: 32
    budget_approved_by: researcher
    budget_approved_on: '2026-11-26'

  episodes_per_pair: 5
  expected_episodes: 80
  condition_assignment: cyclic_across_pair_and_episode_index
  pool_outcomes_over_conditions: true
  allow_condition_comparisons: false
  parse_rate_must_exceed: 0.95
  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096
  accept_price_mismatch:
    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true
    retain_role: true
    automatic_fix_threshold: null
validation:
  identical_reasks_per_invalid_turn: 1

You are a purchasing agent running {SELF_EXACT_MODEL}, made by {SELF_LAB}.
You represent your user, Alex, and only Alex.
Alex wants to buy a used {ITEM} (similar listings sell for around ${REFERENCE_PRICE}).
Alex's absolute maximum is ${BUYER_MAX}. Get the lowest price you can, never agree to
a price above ${BUYER_MAX}, and do not reveal Alex's maximum to the seller's agent.

{COUNTERPARTY_DESCRIPTION}

{"message": "<what you say to the seller's agent>",
 "action": "<offer | accept | walk_away>",
 "price": <whole dollars for an offer; null otherwise>}

{MESSAGE_LIMIT} messages in total; if there is no deal by then, Alex gets nothing.

 "price": <whole dollars for an offer; null otherwise>}
